description: This script contains tests and setup procedures for interacting with 'git svn' and Subversion properties, including importing, initializing, fetching, setting, and confirming properties on files and directories within a Subversion repository integrated with Git.

methods.name: set_props
methods.description: Sets multiple Subversion properties on a specified file within a subdirectory and commits the changes.

methods.name: confirm_props
methods.description: Confirms that certain properties on a specified file within a subdirectory match expected values.
